info.longName: iShares ESG Optimized MSCI USA ETF

funds_data.description: The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is an optimized index designed to maximize exposure to positive environmental, social and governance characteristics while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to the MSCI USA Index.
